Teth'ka, named in-game as Dead Githyanki Warrior, is a githyanki fighter in the Shadow-Cursed Lands during Act Two.

Involvement

Teth'ka's corpse can is in the house where  Oliver plays hide-and-seek. She was training to become a sarth when she was ambushed by shadows in the Shadow-Cursed Lands and killed.

Speak with Dead

  • Who were you?
    • Dead Githyanki Warrior
      Teth'ka... warrior for my Queen... blade for my Kith'rak...
  • How did you die?
    • Dead Githyanki Warrior
      Foolish games... shadow... ambushed...
      • Dead Githyanki Warrior
        Shameful death... dishonour to Vlaakith...
  • Where are you from? (non-Githyanki speaker)
    • Dead Githyanki Warrior
      Crèche Y'llek... hidden among the mountains... veiled by ruins...
  • What crèche do you hail from, kin? (Githyanki speaker)
    • Dead Githyanki Warrior
      Crèche Y'llek... hidden among the mountains... veiled by ruins...
  • Are there other githyanki nearby?
    • Dead Githyanki Warrior
      Not in the shadowlands... Atop the mountain, reaching to the sun...
  • Why were you here?
    • Dead Githyanki Warrior
      Training... becoming a sarth... leading my kin...
  • How do I fight the curse?
    • Narrator
      *The corpse remains silent. It does not know.*
